Water purification

Safe drinking water is the first priority in any survival situation. If the water is clear it may still carry pathogens.

Boiling

Bring water to a rolling boil for at least one full minute at sea level, three minutes above 2000 metres. Boiling kills bacteria, viruses and protozoa.

Chemical treatment

Unscented household bleach (5 to 8 percent sodium hypochlorite) works in a pinch: two drops per litre, wait thirty minutes. Iodine tablets are a portable alternative.

Filtration

A pump filter with a pore size of 0.2 microns removes protozoa and most bacteria. Filters do not remove viruses; combine with chemical treatment.
